item.tib: gsang chen seng ge sgra sgrogs las tshe sgrub g.yung drung brtan pa'i rgya mdud
item.coloph: zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i brda lung yol med du bsil ba tshal nas dngos grub tu brnyes shing slar las ldan grogs kyis bskul ngor kho bo hu chen 'gro 'dul gling pas shar rdza'i dben khrod du shog ser bod yig tu grub pa byas pas/ phyi mo'i yi ge pa ni rnam rgyal tshul khrims kyis bgyis pa'o//
